description: For shared propositional formulas \(A,B\), \([A]=[B]\) exactly when every valuation gives them equal truth values.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.class_eq_iff.{u} {α : Type u}
  (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.classOf A =
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.classOf B ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent A B
